section_summary.extract_value: This abstract describes a single cross-sectional study (Study X) examining body appreciation, BMI, and weight loss efforts among 326 middle-aged Saudi women recruited from primary health centers in Hofuf city. The study found that body appreciation fully mediated the relationship between BMI and weight loss efforts, with mean age 49.14 years and mean BMI 29.64 kg/m².
